prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign ONLY the compact timer summary/entry component at the top of CloudBoard's slide timer settings. This is an additional detail of the same approved lavender timer UX design, not an alternative.
Input image 1: actual current component with total 27:00, work 7:00, rest 2:00, 3 sets, up-chevron; this is the scoped redesign target.
Input image 2: newly proposed full timer editor; use its exact typography, lavender/white color palette, restrained border/radius style as visual reference.
Output a crisp, flat, app-content-only component screenshot, width 390 logical px and height approximately 260 logical px, high resolution around 1560 x 1040. No device bezel/status bar, no outer mockup backdrop, no marketing headings.
White page surface, horizontal margins 24 logical px. A compact pale lavender #F5F4F8 summary surface with restrained 12px corners and NO shadow occupies the top ~150 logical px. Use Pretendard-like Korean font, body 13–15px, ink #202028, muted #777683, accent #77729D, border #E6E3EF.
Inside the summary:
top row: a small outline timer icon followed by label “인터벌” at left. Right-aligned explicit action “편집” followed by a RIGHT chevron. No upward chevron because tapping opens the editor, not an accordion.
Main content row, ample spacing:
Left column: small muted label “총 소요 시간”, underneath large bold accent “27:00”.
Right column: small muted label “반복 구성”, then clearly readable “운동 07:00 → 휴식 02:00”, and next line “위 순서를 3회 반복”.
Bottom quiet small line: “마지막 휴식 포함”.
The math is 7 minutes work + 2 minutes rest repeated 3 times = 27 minutes. Do not show 7 or 2 as aggregate totals. Preserve these settings exactly. One full surface is a coherent entry target, not multiple action cards.
Below the summary, separated by ~20 px whitespace, retain the existing next section without redesigning it: heading “타이머 표시”, small helper “숨겨도 운동 진행은 유지됩니다.”, and compact 3-way segmented control with labels “숫자 + 게이지”, “숫자만”, “안 보임”; the first is selected with subtle lavender. These are subordinate context, not the focal component.
Only one timer summary and one existing display-control context. Keep all Korean text sharp and correctly spelled, avoid crowding, do not add a save CTA, score/metric cards, new tabs, unnecessary badges, decorative charts, or repeated big time values.
